results.title: O3. Hangs up right after naming the problem
transcript: AGENT : Thanks for calling Summit Air. This is the automated assistant. How can I help?
CALLER: Hi, my AC stopped working.
AGENT : Is anyone there who might be at risk in the heat, like a baby, someone older, or someone with health problems?
